hero.eyebrow: Public beta · macOS, Windows, and Linux
hero.title: The Personal Desktop AI Assistant
hero.description: Kucedr turns plain-language requests into useful work. It can edit files, search the web, use connected tools, and create media, all from one desktop app.
hero.note: Open-source software. Bring your own AI providers, follow tool activity, and choose which actions require approval.

personal.title: Kucedr remembers how you work.
personal.description: Choose the context Kucedr can remember and the tools it can use. Saved preferences and useful details carry across conversations, so you spend less time repeating yourself.
personal.outcome: Spend less time tracking routine work and more time on the decisions and ideas that need you.

hero.eyebrow: Desktop AI copilot for macOS, Windows, and Linux
hero.title: Turn knowledge into action.
hero.description: Kucedr works with your files, tools, and chosen AI providers, then turns useful work into reusable Skills, grounded search, a source-aware LLM Wiki, and focused Extensions.
hero.note: Bring your own providers. Keep control of the setup. Follow every tool action in the conversation.

foundation.title: One assistant, from request to result.
foundation.description: Type or speak a request, attach images or PDFs, and let Kucedr work across files, commands, the web, browser interactions, and generated media. Tool activity streams into the conversation, while permission controls govern sensitive file and command actions.

providers.title: Choose the providers behind Kucedr.
providers.description: Kucedr ships 32 built-in provider manifests across chat, speech, media, embeddings, web search, vector retrieval, and object storage. Configure the services you want and keep each capability’s provider selection independent.
providers.note: Catalog and runtime coverage vary by capability.

skills.title: Teach Kucedr the way you work.
skills.description: Turn repeatable workflows into portable Agent Skills. Kucedr routes requests with lightweight skill metadata, loads the full instructions only when they are relevant, and can use the scripts, references, and assets bundled with each skill.
skills.callout: Full instructions arrive only when the task needs them. This provides reusable expertise without placing every playbook into every prompt.

knowledge.title: Find the source. Keep the insight.
knowledge.description: Kucedr uses two complementary knowledge layers. The Knowledge Base retrieves relevant excerpts from indexed text. The LLM Wiki turns changing source material into structured, interlinked Markdown that can be checked, reviewed, and reused.
knowledge.baseDescription: Choose one or more folders of text, create a semantic index with your selected embedding provider and Pinecone, and let Kucedr retrieve matching excerpts with their source paths. Generate the index on demand, keep it refreshed on a schedule, and test searches directly in Settings.
knowledge.wikiTitle: Build knowledge that improves as sources change.
knowledge.wikiDescription: Compile Markdown, text, JSON, CSV, and log files into a persistent, interlinked Markdown wiki. Kucedr preserves source evidence, maintains traceable claims and contradictions, validates every staged update, and incrementally skips sources that have not changed.
knowledge.callout: The wiki gives Kucedr durable synthesis. Raw evidence and the Knowledge Base remain available when an answer needs exact wording or broader retrieval.
knowledge.comparisonTitle: Two knowledge layers, distinct by design.

extensions.title: Small apps. The full power of Kucedr.
extensions.description: Extensions are focused apps with access to Kucedr's AI agent and tools. Open a dedicated interface for events, notes, design, architecture, or any repeatable workflow while the same agent keeps the context and does the work.
extensions.trustDescription: Extensions run in Electron’s sandboxed web runtime, but installed code can access broad Kucedr APIs.

demo.agentDescription: Every extension shares the same agent, context, and permissioned tools.
demo.chatUser: Prepare launch week using the active extension.
demo.assistantIntro: I’ll inspect the extension context, check the workspace, and use the tools it exposes.

draw.title: A focused canvas, only for drawing.
draw.description: Draw is a dedicated extension for sketching, diagramming, and exploring visual ideas. It stays intentionally focused while remaining connected to Kucedr’s settings, agent, and tools.
draw.canvasHint: To move the canvas, hold the spacebar while dragging or use the hand tool
draw.drawHint: Pick a tool and start drawing!

control.title: Your setup. Your providers. Your control.
control.description: Kucedr stores provider keys, settings, conversations, workspace data, Skills, Extensions, and generated wiki files on the user’s machine. The user selects the providers and connected services behind chat, speech, media, search, embeddings, and knowledge generation.
control.disclosureTitle: Local storage is not the same as on-device processing.
control.disclosure: Local storage does not mean every operation stays on-device. Prompts, attachments, source text, document chunks, and tool data may be sent to the AI providers, Pinecone index, MCP servers, websites, or other connected services required for a requested feature.

cta.title: Build an assistant around the way you work.
cta.description: Start with a conversation. Add the skills, knowledge, providers, and extensions that make Kucedr yours.
cta.platforms: Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Open source under the MIT License.

skillPoints: Import agentskills.io-compatible folders built around SKILL.md.
Let Kucedr select an enabled skill by intent, or request one explicitly.
Inspect a skill's identity, authoring metadata, tool requirements, connectors, and tags.
Enable, disable, download, refresh, or delete local skills from Settings.
See a clear activity state in chat whenever Kucedr loads a skill.
knowledgeBasePoints: Recursively indexes readable UTF-8 text while skipping binary files.
Uses the same embedding model for indexing and later queries.
Gives the main assistant relevant excerpts, paths, and relevance scores.
Supports manual generation and scheduled full index rebuilds.
Rejects common credential files and high-confidence secret content before indexing.
wikiPoints: Generates concise source, concept, topic, project, comparison, synthesis, and question pages.
Records source-aware claims, confidence, relationships, contradictions, and open questions.
Keeps immutable evidence snapshots and an append-only operation log.
Stages and validates updates before atomically replacing the generated wiki.
Supports manual generation, cancellation, scheduled maintenance, linting, and review for major synthesis rewrites.
Stores the generated wiki as ordinary Markdown in a user-selected local folder.

controlPoints: File writes, edits, patches, and command execution follow the agent permission policy.
Sensitive actions can surface Deny, Allow once, and Always allow choices.
Tool activity remains visible in the conversation.
The app uses Electron sandboxing, context isolation, disabled Node integration, and web security.
Kucedr runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, with light, dark, and system themes.
